title: Trustworthy agentic lunar robotics: safety-constrained contingent planning with a foundation-model planner
abstract: arXiv:2611.30179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sustained lunar-base operations require robots that restore equipment and deliver cargo under conditions unforeseen before deployment. Flown space autonomy executes pre-validated procedures and enters a safe hold outside their scope, whereas foundation models synthesize plans on site that cannot be verified before execution. We formulate these operations as safety-constrained contingent planning with irreversible actions, erroneous records, three-valued physical evidence, and costly, deadline-constrained sensing. We propose asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the planner as an untrusted black box: reversible actions run on the planner's assumptions, and irreversible actions run only after a minimum-cost sensing cover verifies every precondition. translated_title: 可信赖的智能体月球机器人：采用基础模型规划器的安全约束条件规划
translated_abstract: 持续的月球基地运营需要能够在部署前无法预见的条件下恢复设备并运送货物的机器人。已上天的太空自主系统执行预先验证过的程序，并在超出其适用范围时进入安全保持状态；而基础模型则能够现场合成计划，但这些计划无法在执行前得到验证。我们将此类运营形式化为包含不可逆动作、错误记录、三值物理证据以及昂贵且受截止期限约束的感知的安全约束条件规划问题。我们提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR）方法，将规划器视为不可信的黑箱：可逆动作在规划器的假设下执行，而不可逆动作只有在一个最小成本的感知覆盖验证了其全部前提条件之后才会执行。在测量可靠的前提下，无论采用何种规划器或记录，都不会有任何不可逆动作在错误的前提条件下执行，且不可逆动作之前的感知成本具有下界约束……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出非对称知识级重规划（AKR）方法，将基础模型规划器视为不可信黑箱，通过最小成本感知覆盖确保不可逆动作仅在全部前提条件被验证后才执行，从而在错误记录与不可预见条件下保障月球机器人自主作业的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes asymmetric knowledge-level replanning (AKR), which treats the foundation-model planner as an untrusted black box and guarantees that irreversible actions execute only after minimum-cost sensing verification of all preconditions, ensuring safe autonomous lunar robotics under erroneous records and unforeseen conditions.
